notes.title: Patch v2.7.4
notes.notes:
Hello dear employees,

Today we have a really small fix about a silly mistake Doshi made on the previous version !

This patch is fixing the issue regarding the lock issue after pressing the A button on the gamepad during a cutscene.

Thanks to employee harbourmur for pointing the issue first. Way to get promoted !

Have a good day, enjoy a coffee and a little break of 10 minutes to cry a bit.

notes.title: Patch v2.7.3
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Sintracorp employees,

Today we bring you a technical update.
Nothing fancy, some bug fixes and an update of the engine core to have better performances and compatibility.

Thanks for your attention, and see you this afternoon at the birthday party.

notes.title: Patch V2.6.5
notes.notes:
Hello fellow employees.

Very short meeting today.
A minor patch is out today, increasing a bit more compatibility on all systems.
That's all, I told you it'll be short !

You can enjoy 1 free minute to cry a bit before going back to your desk.

Work , Work , Work !

notes.title: Patch V2.6.4
notes.notes:
Good day fellow employees,

Today we have a minor patch fixing some issues :
[list]
[*]Sound not working at all in some rare cases.
[*]Game start blocked with corrupted save data
[*]Some timing issue that could lead to infinite loop
[/list]
If you face any problem, don't hesitate to get to floor 3 and say it to Doshi.

Peace, man.

notes.title: Patch v2.6.1
notes.notes:
Hello fellow employees,

Doshi made a few fixes, nothing too important : 
[list]
[*]Smoother smoothness : it could happen that the game was not as smooth as Doshi likes things to be. A fix has been made to ensure that if the game has vsync, then the screen refresh rate is used as expected for the game.
[*]Consistency check fix : If a save file is corrupted, the game could lock up on startup. The employee responsible for this issue has been fired, you can pick up his belongings on floor 4, near the HR offices.
[/list]

Thanks to our dear players [b]Deus_nsf[/b] and [b]mike oxmaul[/b] for helping about the smoothness issue !


Peace man !

notes.title: Update to v2.6
notes.notes:
Hello fellow employees.

Today's meeting is about the new version of Yuppie Psycho.

We worked a lot to continue improving our game so that anyone could play it.
[i]( I know some will be disappointed, but this update [u]does not contain any new content[/u])[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32192720/27505cb6c8472ffe4339fc967cae406dfcaf461a.jpg[/img]

[b]In this new version :[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Mac support is back[/b] : The game is back on Apple computers. It's still in beta though, so if you have some trouble running the game, let us know.
[*][b]Reducing light flashes[/b] : We added a new option to help reduce the discomfort due to light flashes that one could feel while playing the game. It was a challenge to do that 3 years after release. 
( Thanks to @ihatestyx for the help. )
[*][b]Some UI fixes[/b] : We made a few fixes to make the UI more usable. 
( Thanks to @Yung Gus for pointing some of them )
[/list]

If you ever face an issue or a blocker, please reach us on the Steam forums or directly on our support email.
( see https://steamcommunity.com/app/597760/discussions/1/1675812484343766436/ )

Meeting is over, get back to your desk and please avoid the coffee machines for a while.
It seems like someone replaced coffee with ink.

Work Work Work !

notes.title: Patch v2.5.14
notes.notes:
Here we go again for a minor patch.

This time we fixed some french translation mistake and we updated the outdated links in the extra section.

Told you this was a small one.

Have fun !

here's a quick patch about an issue regarding hero walk speed and troublesome cutscenes.

notes.title: patch notes for v2.0.58 - minor changes for chinese players
notes.notes:
Hello fellow employees.

We made a small update focused on our dear chinese players.
We often receive complaints about the game not responsive to keyboard input when the Windows Input Method is set to Chinese.
What happens is that the keyboard inputs are catched by the OS, and the game engine has no idea that an input even occured.

This update is here to detect this very case and warn the player to switch to international Input Method.

Thanks for attending this meeting, you may now get back to your cubicle.

notes.title: Update V1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello fellow coworkers.

The IT department sent us a new update today.

You'll find in it : 
- Better French and Russian localization
- The "Voice" achievement is now unlockable.
- Some fixes made to help with people having video issues.


Please let us know if the fixes are working for you or not :)

Have fun dear coworkers, but only in the canteen and between 11.30 AM to 1.30 PM.

notes.title: Update V1.0.3
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Here's a small list of the content of this new version, mainly focused on game controllers : 

- Xbox Dpad is now working out of the box
- PS4 buttons have been remapped to fit more to PS usages.
- Wireless gamepads that go to sleep are now correctly reconnected when waking up
- There are now 2 Steam Input configurations for Switch Pro Controller, and Steam Controller

- a few text fixes here and there

- a few map fixes.

Have fun !
